entries.title: I Corinthians 16:1
segments: ¶Now about the giving of money for the saints, as I gave orders to the churches of Galatia, so do you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:2
segments: On the first day of the week, let every one of you put by him in store, in measure as he has done well in business, so that it may not be necessary to get money together when I come.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:3
segments: And when I come, I will send the men of your selection with letters to take the money you have got together to Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:4
segments: And if it is possible for me to go there, they will go with me.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:5
segments: ¶But I will come to you after I have gone through Macedonia, for that is my purpose;

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:6
segments: But I may be with you for a time, or even for the winter, so that you may see me on my way, wherever I go.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:7
segments: For it is not my desire to see you now, on my way; because it is my hope to be with you for some time, if that is the Lord's pleasure.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:8
segments: But I will be at Ephesus till Pentecost;

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:9
segments: For a great and important door there is open to me, and there are a number of people against me.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:10
segments: ¶Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear; because he is doing the Lord's work, even as I am:

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:11
segments: See then that he has the honour which is right. But send him on his way in peace, so that he may come to me: for I am looking for him with the brothers.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:12
segments: But as for Apollos, the brother, I had a great desire for him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not his pleasure to come now; but he will come when he has a chance.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:13
segments: ¶Be on the watch, unmoved in the faith, and be strong like men.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:14
segments: Let all you do be done in love.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:15
segments: Now I make my request to you, my brothers, for you have knowledge that the house of Stephanas is the first-fruits of Achaia, and that they have made themselves the servants of the saints,

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:16
segments: That you put yourselves under such, and under everyone who is helping the Lord's work.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:17
segments: And I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for they have done what was needed to make your work complete.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:18
segments: For they gave comfort to my spirit and to yours: for which cause give respect to such people.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:19
segments: ¶The churches of Asia send their love to you. So do Aquila and Prisca, with the church which is in their house.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:20
segments: All the brothers send their love to you. Give one another a holy kiss.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:21
segments: I, Paul, send you these words of love in my writing.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:22
segments: If any man has not love for the Lord, let him be cursed. Maran atha (our Lord comes).

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:23
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:24
segments: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. So be it.
